candidate_windows.window_text: We conduct experiments with four representative LLMs: Zephyr-7B-beta (Tunstall et al., 2023), Vicuna-13B-v1.5 (Zheng et al., 2023), GPT-3.5, and GPT-4 (Achiam et al., 2023). Following previous work (Touvron et al., 2023), we adjust personality-aware instructions to the prompt format of each model. For tutoring simulation (Section 3), both teacher and student roles use the same model, and we feed the concatenated utterances for dialogue generation. For fair comparison and reliable analysis results, we use GPT-4 for all the validation tasks (Section 3.3). We randomly sampled 100 open-sourced cartoon images and used their image description to generate 500 tutoring dialogues. The total utterance number is $10\mathrm{K}$ .

For the computational experiments, open language models (e.g., Vicuna, Zephyr) are used with Pytorch and Hugging Face Transformers, running on a Single A100 80G GPU.
